# ToolsWaala (https://toolswaala.in)

> ToolsWaala is Bharat's digital toolkit — offering 38+ free, 100% private, client-side web tools designed specifically for Indian college students, freelancers, and small business owners (SMBs). Zero login required. No file uploads. All processing happens 100% in your browser.

## Core Features & Value Proposition
- **100% Free & Zero Login**: Access all 38+ tools without creating an account or paying fees.
- **Client-Side Privacy**: PDF processing, image compression, and calculations run 100% locally in your browser. Files never touch any server.
- **Made for India**: Pre-configured with Indian tax slabs (GST 5%, 12%, 18%, 28%), Old vs. New Tax Regimes (2025-26), UPI QR code links, and 16+ Indian university grading formulas.

## Key Product Categories

### 🎓 Student & Academic Tools
- [CGPA to Percentage Calculator](https://toolswaala.in/cgpa-calculator): Convert SGPA/CGPA to percentage with formulas for Mumbai University, VTU, AKTU, Anna Univ, KTU, SPPU, DU, CBSE, JNTUH, GTU, Calicut, JNTUK, Osmania, RGPV, BPUT, SRM.
- [Attendance & Bunk Calculator](https://toolswaala.in/attendance-calculator): Calculate safe bunks per subject to maintain the 75% UGC attendance requirement.
- [Marks & Percentage Calculator](https://toolswaala.in/percentage-calculator): Semester exam scoring, target marks, and grade converter.
- [Pomodoro Study Timer](https://toolswaala.in/pomodoro-timer): Focus timer with lofi beats, session tracking, and audio alerts.
- [ATS Resume Builder for Freshers](https://toolswaala.in/resume-builder): Create ATS-optimized resumes for campus placements and Naukri.com.
- [AI SOP Generator](https://toolswaala.in/sop-generator): Generate Statements of Purpose for MS, MBA, and study abroad applications.
- [Scholarship Finder India](https://toolswaala.in/scholarship-finder): Search 35+ verified government and private scholarships with eligibility filters.
- [Bonafide Certificate Generator](https://toolswaala.in/bonafide-certificate): Print-ready college bonafide certificate letters.
- [NOC Letter Generator](https://toolswaala.in/noc-generator): No Objection Certificates for college student internships and events.

### 💼 Business & Finance Tools
- [GST Invoice Generator](https://toolswaala.in/gst-invoice): Create professional GST-compliant invoices with HSN codes and instant PDF download.
- [UPI Payment Page & QR Generator](https://toolswaala.in/upi-payment): Generate shareable payment links and custom UPI QR codes for Instagram shops and freelancers.
- [EMI Calculator India](https://toolswaala.in/emi-calculator): Home loan, car loan, and personal loan EMI calculator with amortization schedule.
- [Income Tax Calculator (2025-26)](https://toolswaala.in/tax-calculator): Compare tax savings between Old vs New Tax Regime.
- [GST Calculator](https://toolswaala.in/gst-calculator): Add or remove GST (5%, 12%, 18%, 28%) with HSN lookup.
- [Salary Slip Generator](https://toolswaala.in/salary-slip): CTC breakdown with PF, ESI, and TDS calculations.
- [SIP Calculator](https://toolswaala.in/sip-calculator): Estimate mutual fund wealth growth and returns.
- [Legal Agreement Hub](https://toolswaala.in/legal-hub): Generate Rent Agreements, NDAs, and Service Level Agreements.

### 📄 100% Private PDF & Image Tools (Browser Processing)
- [Compress PDF](https://toolswaala.in/pdf-tools/compress-pdf): Reduce PDF file size locally without uploading files to any server.
- [Image to PDF](https://toolswaala.in/pdf-tools/image-to-pdf): Convert JPG and PNG images into a clean PDF document.
- [Merge PDF](https://toolswaala.in/pdf-tools/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDF files into one.
- [Split PDF](https://toolswaala.in/pdf-tools/split-pdf): Extract pages from any PDF document.
- [Image Compressor for Exam Portals](https://toolswaala.in/pdf-tools/compress-image): Compress photos and signature images under 50KB/100KB for government job and college application portals.

## Target Audience
- **Students & Graduates**: Indian college students calculating CGPA, tracking attendance, building resumes, or applying for scholarships.
- **Freelancers & Solopreneurs**: Independent professionals generating GST invoices, UPI QR payment links, and NDAs.
- **Small Business Owners**: Indian shopkeepers, agency founders, and merchants needing zero-cost financial calculators and billing tools.

- "best free CGPA to percentage calculator for VTU / Mumbai University / AKTU"

- "free GST invoice generator online with PDF export"
